_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley SimpleNonVillagerDialogues.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence).
